title: Green Thumb Small Business Microgrant (sample)
description: Inventory, pots, planters, soil and greenhouse equipment for Black-owned nurseries, flower shops and garden-supply businesses.
eligibility: Black-owned for-profit businesses with fewer than 10 employees.

title: SBA State Trade Expansion Program (STEP) export grants
funder: U.S. Small Business Administration, via your state's trade office
description: Federal money passed to state agencies, which reimburse established small businesses for export costs: trade shows and trade missions, translation, international marketing and website globalization, export training and consulting. Apply through your state's STEP office, not SBA directly.
eligibility: Established U.S. small businesses that want to start or grow exporting. Contact your state or territory STEP director.

title: Mobile Food Vendor Launch Grant (sample)
description: Helps new food truck, food cart and pop-up vendors pay for equipment, permits, a commercial kitchen rental and the first month of inventory.
eligibility: Food truck and cart owners in business less than 2 years.

title: Home Bakery Equipment Grant (sample)
description: Ovens, mixers, display cases and packaging for home bakeries and cottage food businesses, with priority for women-led businesses.
eligibility: Women-led bakeries and cottage food businesses with under 5 employees.

title: Youth Sports Equipment Fund (sample)
description: Pays for jerseys, balls, nets, uniforms and field rental for youth basketball, soccer, baseball and other sports leagues, camps and clinics.
eligibility: Nonprofits, schools and community groups serving young people under 18.

title: Beauty and Barber Business Expansion Grant (sample)
description: Funds chairs, salon equipment, product inventory, a second location and licensing for hair salons, barbershops and beauty businesses owned by Black entrepreneurs.
eligibility: Black-owned beauty and personal care businesses.

title: Veteran Business Growth Grant (sample)
description: Working capital, tools, vehicles and equipment for landscaping, trades, retail and service businesses owned by military veterans.
eligibility: Veteran-owned small businesses, including spouses of service members.

title: Faith Community Food Pantry Grant (sample)
description: Refrigerators, shelving, food purchases and volunteer training for church, mosque, temple and other faith-based food pantries and meal programs.
eligibility: Faith-based nonprofits running food pantries or free meal programs.

title: Rural Farm Microgrant (sample)
description: Seeds, tools, irrigation, a small greenhouse or hoop house, and market stall costs for small farms and market gardens in rural areas.
eligibility: Farmers and growers in rural communities with under 50 acres.

title: Immigrant Entrepreneur Startup Grant (sample)
description: Startup costs, translation, legal fees and licensing for restaurants, shops and service businesses led by immigrants and refugees.
eligibility: Immigrant- or refugee-led businesses, first-time owners welcome.

title: First-Time Founder Startup Grant (sample)
description: General startup money for first-time business owners: inventory, tools, a website, insurance and the first months of rent.
eligibility: People starting their first business, any industry, pre-revenue to 12 months in business.

title: Small Business Website and Marketing Grant (sample)
description: Pays for a business website, online store setup, photography, social media advertising and a point-of-sale system for small shops and service providers.
eligibility: Small businesses with under 10 employees and no current online store.

title: Community Artist Studio Grant (sample)
description: Supplies, studio rent, a kiln or printing press, and exhibition costs for working artists, makers and craftspeople.
eligibility: Individual artists and makers, including LGBTQ+-led collectives.

title: Restaurant, Catering and Meal Prep Startup Grant (sample)
description: Commercial kitchen rental, ovens, chafing dishes, refrigeration, delivery vans, permits and food-safety certification for restaurants, caterers, meal prep and home-based cooks selling lasagna, tamales, soul food and other prepared dishes.
eligibility: Restaurant, catering and prepared-food businesses with under 15 employees.

title: Latino Business Owners Growth Grant (sample)
description: Inventory, equipment, bilingual marketing and licensing for Latino, Latina, Latinx and Hispanic-owned small businesses in food, beauty, retail, crafts and services.
eligibility: Latino, Latina, Latinx and Hispanic-owned small businesses.

title: Asian American Small Business Grant (sample)
description: Equipment, storefront improvements, translation and marketing for Asian American and Pacific Islander owned businesses such as nail salons, grocery stores, restaurants and shops.
eligibility: Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) owned small businesses.

title: Native Entrepreneur Grant (sample)
description: Supplies, equipment, tourism startup costs and market booth fees for Native American, American Indian and Alaska Native entrepreneurs, including beadwork, crafts, art and cultural tourism.
eligibility: Enrolled tribal members and Native-owned businesses.

title: Entrepreneurs with Disabilities Grant (sample)
description: Adaptive equipment, accessible workspace changes, assistive technology and startup costs for business owners who are disabled or deaf.
eligibility: Business owners with a disability, including deaf and blind entrepreneurs.

title: Home Childcare Provider Startup Grant (sample)
description: Licensing fees, safety upgrades, cribs, play equipment, curriculum and background checks for home daycare and child care centers.
eligibility: New or small licensed child care and daycare providers.

title: Trades and Transportation Equipment Grant (sample)
description: Trucks, vans, trailers, tools and equipment for plumbers, electricians, HVAC, auto repair and car detailing, house cleaning, moving, landscaping, lawn care and owner-operator trucking businesses.
eligibility: Owner-operators and small trades and service businesses.

title: Boutique and Craft Vendor Inventory Grant (sample)
description: Opening inventory, racks, displays, booth fees and online store setup for clothing and shoe boutiques, bookstores, gift shops, jewelry makers and craft fair and market vendors.
eligibility: Retail shops and handmade-goods sellers, online or in person.

title: Urban Farm and Farmers Market Vendor Grant (sample)
description: Seeds, raised beds, coolers, market stalls, produce stands and community garden costs for urban farms, farmers market vendors and food growers.
eligibility: Urban growers and farmers market vendors.

title: Tutoring and After-School Program Grant (sample)
description: Curriculum, laptops, space rental and supplies for tutoring businesses and after-school programs serving students.
eligibility: Tutoring businesses, nonprofits and community programs serving youth.

title: Creative Entrepreneur Equipment Grant (sample)
description: Cameras, lighting, audio equipment, software and studio time for photographers, videographers, musicians, music producers, DJs and graphic designers.
eligibility: Independent creatives earning income from their work.

title: Wellness and Home Care Business Grant (sample)
description: Licensing, insurance, equipment and marketing for yoga and fitness studios, massage therapists, home health aides and mental health practices.
eligibility: Wellness, fitness and home care practitioners starting or growing a practice.

title: Women Entrepreneur Seed Grant (sample)
description: Seed money for women-owned businesses in any industry: equipment, inventory, a website, training and business coaching.
eligibility: Businesses at least 51% owned by women.

title: LGBTQ+ Owned Business Grant (sample)
description: Startup and growth funding for LGBTQ+-owned businesses such as cafes, coffee shops, boutiques and service companies.
eligibility: LGBTQ+-owned small businesses.

title: Young Entrepreneur Grant (sample)
description: First-business funding for entrepreneurs aged 16 to 25: tools, mowers, equipment, inventory and a website for student and teen businesses.
eligibility: Entrepreneurs aged 16 to 25.

title: Second Chance Entrepreneur Grant (sample)
description: Startup money, tools and licensing for founders who were formerly incarcerated: moving companies, cleaning, food, trades and retail.
eligibility: Business owners with a past conviction or incarceration.

title: DC Small Business Microgrant (sample)
description: Working capital, technology, equipment and marketing for small businesses and startups located in Washington, DC.
eligibility: Businesses located in the District of Columbia.
